Usage:
  pdiffy <before> <after> [--html <report.html>]   Compare two PDFs, two DOCX files or two snapshot files
         [--json [<changes.json>]]                  --json prints the changes as JSON instead, or saves them
         [--profile <profile>]                      content, accessibility, layout or strict (the default)
         [--checks]                                 --checks also compares what the checks find
         [--remediation]                            --remediation compares a PDF with its remediated
                                                    version, content changes first
  pdiffy compare <before> <after> [--html <index.html>] [--json [<changes.json>]] [--profile <profile>]
         [--checks]                                 Compare two folders, file by file
  pdiffy snapshot <file.pdf|file.docx> [<out>]      Print or save a PDF's or DOCX's snapshot
         [--profile <profile>] [--checks]           --checks adds what the checks find
  pdiffy check <file.pdf|file.docx>                 Run every built-in check on a PDF or DOCX
         [--html <report.html>]                     --html also saves the findings as a page
         [--json [<findings.json>]]                 --json prints them as JSON instead, or saves them
  pdiffy read <file.pdf|file.docx>                  Print what a screen reader announces, in reading order
  pdiffy accept [<files or folders>] [--all]        Accept received snapshots as verified, or with rules,
         [--no-accessibility]                       only those with no change that can affect accessibility,
         [--only-sections <section,...>]            whose changes are all in these sections,
         [--group <n>]                              and that are in group n of pdiffy report
  pdiffy review [<files or folders>] [--all]        Step through received snapshots, accepting or skipping
                                                    each one or opening its report
  pdiffy report [<files or folders>] [--all] [--html <summary.html>] [--markdown <
